answer_1.quote: We assess our method on four state-of-the-art multimodal language models ... Performance is evaluated using the AMBER dataset, tailored for image description tasks. ... We further validate on the MS COCO captioning benchmark.

answer_2.quote: Evaluation metrics span detection performance (AUC and accuracy), text quality (PPL and BLEU), semantic alignment (STS and BertScore), and robustness against attacks.
